Studio album by Dismal Euphony Released 22 March 1999 Recorded The Woodhouse Studios in September 1998 Genre Symphonic black metal , heavy metal Length 39 : 00 Language English Label Nuclear Blast Records Producer Waldemar Sorychta Professional ratings Review scores Source Rating AllMusic [ 1 ] All Little Devils is the third studio album by the Norwegian gothic metal band Dismal Euphony .
